generation_history.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER ONLY: match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, restrained detail, generous blank areas and consistent visual density. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: Xu Guo Stone Archway (许国石坊), Shexian, Anhui, built 1584. Draw this photographed FRONT facade, not a generic paifang: four tall square stone pillars define three passages; the central entablature and roof stand higher than the two flanking ones, with projecting stone imitation-timber brackets, upright pillar ends continuing above the small stone roofs, broad carved stone panels and paired carved lion supports at pillar bases. The complete monument is eight-pillared and four-sided in plan; this plate depicts its front facade with four visible front pillars, not eight pillars in one row. Keep the photographed distinctive rather flat stone eaves, beam proportions and restrained selective carving. No invented tiled pavilion roof or extra storeys.
Create a refined sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white. Use outlines rather than filled black passageways. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script.
Show the whole facade centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, verticals vertical, minimal perspective. Landscape 1536x1024. Monument occupies about 80% canvas width with breathing room above the top pillar ends and below the bases; every edge uncut. Remove the tourists, shops, nearby houses, tree, sky, timestamp and all signage. Use only a few short ground lines. Preserve ornament selectively; leave ALL inscription panels blank, no characters, labels, captions, lettering, watermark, frame or border.
